name: production boundary: pin: a deploy after a double-quoted parenthesis inside a double-quoted arithmetic opening is denied as a production deploy

source.assertion:
assert_equals "pin: a deploy after a double-quoted parenthesis inside a double-quoted arithmetic opening is denied as a production deploy" \
  "deny" "$(verdict_for 'echo "$(( "(" ) ; vercel --prod ))"')"

contains: so a production deploy stays with the operator
